title: Psilocybin reproducibility
abstract: Psilocybin is shown in this study to produce consistent acute behavioural effects but small or absent sustained effects, which could explain the lack of robustness and reproducibility in past studies.
abstract_zh: 本研究表明，裸盖菇素可产生一致的急性行为效应，但持续效应小或不存在，这可能解释了以往研究中缺乏稳健性和可重复性的原因。
snippet: Psilocybin is shown in this study to produce consistent acute behavioural effects but small or absent sustained effects, which could explain the lack of robustness and reproducibility in past studies.
